sanjay: Heads-up — Brightline reported a sudden drop in embeddings throughput starting ~03:10 UTC. vectors/sec collapsed but tokens/sec looks unchanged. also seeing intermittent 401s for a subset of their requests. billing counter spiked for a short window.

maria: can you paste the numbers / any error payloads?

sanjay: metrics snippet pasted:```
vectors/sec: 12,400 (baseline ~48k)
tokens/sec: 218,000 (no change)
GPU util: 97% on p4d.pool-7
avg queue depth (embed workers): 420
embed latency p50/p95: 22ms / 180ms (was 8ms / 25ms)
error 401 rate: ~0.8% for api key X-REDACTED between 03:10-03:18
billing spikes: short burst of 4x token billing events (investigating)
```

ingrid: do you have a sample request/response showing the 401 or dim mismatch?

sanjay: here's a cropped client repro (customer SDK):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer X-REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-standard","input":["where to buy coffee","redwood inference"]}'
```
response (error):```json
{ "error": "DimensionMismatch: expected 1536, got 1024" }
```
note: they say they never changed clients, just started seeing mismatch + throttle.

maria: interesting — dimension mismatch usually indicates a variant change. checking routing table for alias embed-standard...

deploy-bot: rollout event at 3001234500: alias embed-standard updated -> 10% traffic to embed-compact-v1 (dim=1024), 90% -> embed-standard-v2 (dim=1536). triggered by rollout id r-2026-03-17-embed-compact-canary.

maria: that matches. if the alias served a compact variant, some customers expecting 1536 would get 1024 and client-side validation might throw that error. but why does tokens/sec stay stable while vectors/sec falls and GPU is saturated?

tom: probable cause: compact variant changes kernel selection and reduces per-request compute but breaks batching compatibility between workers (we route mixed dims to different roots). small batches (many 1-item requests from Brightline) would cause more kernel launch overhead and lower GPU batching efficiency. also when router falls back to the compact variant mid-batch it can force synchronous processing and smaller effective batch sizes — that would reduce vectors/sec even if token accounting (which is handled earlier in the pipeline) remains similar.

lila: also saw earlier that the rollout reduced the global batch window from 20ms -> 8ms (auto-adjust picked smaller target because of perceived lower p50). smaller window+mixed-dim variance = many tiny batches hitting GPUs -> queue depth and util spike.

maria: repro steps I ran in staging to mimic Brightline pattern: 1) pin alias to 10% compact as in deploy-bot, 2) run 300 concurrent clients with 1-2 inputs each, 3) observe embed workers: queue depth rises and per-GPU batch size drops to 2-3. curl example:```bash
for i in {1..300}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://staging-api/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-standard","input":["a","b"]}' &
done
wait
```
observed: vectors/sec ~11k, p95 latency ~220ms, GPUs at 95-99% but low effective batch tokens per kernel.

ingrid: any 401 correlation? could be client retries hitting wrong alias or intermittent auth validation errors when routing nodes changed. logs?

maria: auth log snippet:```
[03:11:02] auth-check failed for key X-REDACTED: upstream auth service 502 -> client retried -> subsequent request hit compact variant and failed dim check
```
so some retries + mixed routing might amplify tail effects.

tom: mitigation plan: immediate - pin Brightline to embed-standard-v2 (1536) and remove compact from their routing; rollback the canary to 0% while we analyze. medium - increase batch_window to 40ms for embeddings to re-form larger batches; long - ensure variant-dim-aware routing (reject/translate at gateway instead of mixing dims in same batch).

lila: created support ACL to pin customer to model id for region eu-west-1: applied. also bumped batch_window on embed workers in eu-west to 40ms as temporary.

maria: post-mitigation metrics (03:18 UTC):```
vectors/sec: 46,800
tokens/sec: 224,000
GPU util: 82%
avg queue depth: 120
latency p95: 28ms
error 401: 0.02%
```
looks back to baseline.

sanjay: thanks team — I'll open a customer incident (Brightline) and note root cause as unintended alias canary mixing dims + auth retry interplay.

ingrid: action items: 1) experiments team to add a preflight dim check at the gateway to return a clear 409 instead of letting the mismatch percolate (assigned: tom), 2) infra team to add canary guardrails that prevent variants with different output shapes from being in the same alias (assigned: maria), 3) support: confirm billing adjustments for the spike (assigned: sanjay).

deploy-bot: created issue INC-3001 tracking rollback + guardrails.

ops-bot: note: scheduled follow-up postmortem meeting 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC.

sanjay: closing loop with customer now. :thumbsup: 

maria: will draft postmortem and add metrics + reproduction script to the runbook.

lila: nice catch everyone. :white_check_mark:
